lines.english: "…That's how it is. So can I count on you to join, Setsuna?"
"…Hey, Setsuna."
"Ah, s-sorry. I wasn't listening."
"Jeez, this is our once-a-month girls' night out. Try focusing on having fun with us instead of letting your mind wander off."
"Are you a bit tired, Setsuna?"
"N-No, I'm fine. Sorry, let me hear what you said one more time."
When Tomo started talking to me, the hand of the clock was pointing exactly at 9 PM.
"Like I said, it's about the live performance! They're doing a live performance in October for the 10 year anniversary of Troy."
"Live… huh."
Today is our usual once-a-month girls' night out.
Takeya-kun should be with him in my stead right about now. In other words, it's the day I can finally enjoy myself without having to worry about anything.
But…
"Right, it's an all-night showing of all the regulars. It'll start Saturday night and will continue until everyone's performed.
"How should I put it… Seems like they're pretty loose with time, huh."
"Haha, that's just like Troy. Everyone gets along so well there. They don't seem to have any rivalries at all."
"It'll begin at 6 PM on the first Saturday of October. You'll come, right?"
"Hmm, I don't think I can handle the entire night. I guess I'll just check out the performers that I know. I really hope they come early on."
"No, you won't be checking it out… You'll be the one performing, Setsuna."
Our outings like these are supposed to be breathers from everyday stress, yet now, it's beginning to weigh heavily on me.
"I said 'all the regulars,' right? So obviously Routes will perform. In other words, our beloved songstress SETSUNA will perform too!"
"Ah, that sounds great. I haven't heard Setsuna sing in so long. I look forward to hearing it."
"Eh? B-But… I'm just a backup singer."
"The only person who thinks that way is you, Setsuna.
In fact, the members have all asked me to convince you to come."
"No way…"
On top of that, Tomo is bringing up something way heavier than usual…
"Routes is really popular so they might appear last. It's entirely possible you'll have to stay the entire night."
"Ah… In that case, I'll have to call it off. I can't go."
"It's on the weekend, so what's the problem? I'll convince your parents to let you go."
"…The weekend is an even worse time for me. Tomo, you know that, right?"
"Setsuna…"
"But it's just a single day, and it's the anniversary of Troy. They've helped you out more than once in the past."
"But I'll have to rehearse, right? I'll be forced to take countless days off, right?"
"Just one or two days should be enough. You can rehearse the rest during karaoke."
The way Tomo is in high spirits like always… Today, it feels painful somehow.
"Oh, right! You can even invite Kitahara-san if you want. He might actually get a bit better if he sees you sing."
"No way! There's no way I could allow Haruki-kun to be in a crowded place."
Yes, this girl never changes, ever staying at her own pace.
I'm aware of that. I'm fully aware of that, but…
"You don't have to be so angry, Setsuna. She just didn't know about that."
"I-I'm not angry… I just wanted her to understand. I just wanted her to understand Haruki-kun."
"W-Well, you know how I am. Sometimes I get too pushy and people get annoyed with me."
Why won't she change for my sake…?
Whose fault is it that I'm feeling this way?
"Still, you should enjoy yourself, Setsuna. Have enough fun for both you and Kitahara-san."
"…Have fun for Haruki-kun too?"
"Exactly! You said it yourself. Don't you remember?"
"I realized, just recently."
"That unless I enjoy my own life to the fullest, I can't put a smile on his face."
"You can't stay this way… You'll both go under if you continue like this…"
Thinking back at those words, they lack so much understanding and delicacy that it almost feels like someone else said them.
"I understand that you want to take on all his suffering, but he's not gonna get better just because you suffer yourself, Setsuna.
"Even then… I can't right now."
"Setsuna!"
"There's a time and place for being so easygoing!"
The person who said those words… I doubt I could be friends with them…
"And this just isn't the time!"
"Setsuna…"
"You wouldn't understand, Tomo! No one could possibly understand!"
"Setsuna."
"That's enough. Let's call it a day."
"I-Io?"
"It's okay, you can go to Haruki's place. I noticed you were looking anxiously at the clock anyway."
"Ah…"
The rainy season ended, and the true summer arrived.
The sky soaring high above, deep in blue. The raging sun so powerful, as if its true strength has finally been unveiled to us.
However…
The gloomy dimness of my own world refuses to be chased away.
"Ug… uu… aaah…!"
"And here I was wondering why you guys called me back so early. Who would've thought it was for something like this."
"Yeah, I'm sorry. She's just too much for me to handle alone."
"I… I… made Setsuna angry again…! Uaaaaah…"
"You said exactly what you had to. You wouldn't be Yanagihara Tomo if you hadn't."
"Y-You think so? Really…?"
"Yes, really. For once, Setsuna is the one in the wrong. I know you did the right thing."
"But… What's the point of being right if Setsuna won't listen to me? Uuuaah… hah… uuu…"
"She'll realize in time, so please… I said this before, but… don't ever stop being Setsuna's ally."
"O-Okay, okay…! Uaaaaaaaaaaaah!"
"…You guys better make this your treat, got it? Least you could do for making me drink this lousy booze."
"Zzz… zzz…"
"I see, so that's how it was…"
"Well, so what's actually going on with Haruki's condition?"
"Nothing's changed. Sometimes he sleeps through entire days, but it's not like he's any less asleep when he's awake."
"I see…"
"Though I suppose he doesn't seem to be about to do anything stupid on impulse either, so I guess things are stable for now."
"Then why is Setsuna so…"
"I imagine that for Setsuna, Haruki not changing is the very thing that is putting pressure on her."
"Hm…"
"Perhaps she's beginning to think that she's not of any help to him; that perhaps she's just getting in his way."
"But wasn't she the one who told us? That things like these take time, so we have to look at the big picture."
"She was probably still hoping for some results. Anything that would show that Haruki has gotten at least a little bit better."
"And that hope slowly, slowly turned into despair, and it began to wear away at her heart…"
"Not good signs at all. That's obviously true for Haruki, but it goes doubly so for Setsuna."
"What do we do…?"
"I hate to admit it, but I don't have the answer to that right now. There's a limit to what the two of us can do for them."
"Then, who can… save those two?"
"Maybe they'll have to sort it out among themselves in the end. Haruki, Setsuna, and…"
"That's… not possible."
"Mh…"
"Even if Haruki gets better as a result, it'll be the end of those two."
"Perhaps… that'll be the right time to cross that bridge."
"Perhaps some people aren't destined to be together, incompatible even, no matter how much they love each other."
"Which one are you talking about?"
"Beats me."
"Aaah, and here I was all cheery over my bonus paycheck, but now the mood is completely spoiled. Whaddya think? Want another round of drinks?"
"Before we get to that… we'll have to take care of this chick."
"Zzzzzzzz…… zzzzzzz…"
"Well… I suppose someone has to get her home safely."
"You're saying I get to take her home?"
"Obviously not."
"Then how about we call it a day and you carry her back? Or would you rather we all left together, the three of us, and send her home first?"
"The three of us."
"Oh, unusual for you to answer so quickly."
"Physical labor is obviously the man's job."
"Those are some ancient values you've got there. Besides, you've got many times the horsepower I do."
"How rude… Besides, we can't go for another round of drinks if we separate here."
"Wow, you've gotten a lot better at hanging out."
"Call it being grown-up."
"Does that mean we'll have a 'grown-up hang out' later?"
"Stop being stupid and help Tomo already. I'll handle the bill."
"Roger that.
Heey, Tomo, how about at least walking to the taxi?"
"Mh? Nhmmmmm…"
"…It's about time you grew up as well."
